test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A type of brake has a diaphragm operating in a cylinder. For application of brakes on one side, a diaphragm is subjected to atmospheric pressure while the other is applied negative pressure by exhausting air known as _____ brake.
solution:
The correct answer is __vacuum.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vacuum brake__ is a type of brake that operates using a diaphragm in a cylinder.
 
• For application of brakes, one side of the diaphragm is subjected to atmospheric pressure, while negative pressure is applied to the other side by exhausting air.
 
• This mechanism is commonly used in railways and other heavy vehicles.
 
• The system relies on pressure differentials to create the braking effect.
 
• Vacuum brakes are known for their simplicity and efficiency in operation.
 
• They are widely used in older train systems and have largely been replaced by air brakes in modern systems.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydraulic Brake:**

 
 
• Uses hydraulic fluid to transfer pressure from the brake pedal to the brake mechanism.
 
• Commonly used in modern vehicles.
 
 
 
• **Air Brake:**
 
 
• Operates using compressed air to apply pressure on brake pads or drums.
 
• Widely used in heavy commercial vehicles and trains.
 
 
 
• **Electric Brake:**
 
 
• Uses electricity to actuate the braking mechanism.
 
• Common in electric and hybrid vehicles.
